name: Dorfkrug Appartements
beschreibung: The Dorfkrug Appartements are located in the center of Telfs. The accommodation offers holiday apartments with a kitchenette and separate bedrooms. The Kühtai ski area and the Hohe Munde hiking region can be reached from here. The furnishings are functional and designed for self-catering use. Shops for everyday necessities are in the immediate vicinity. Guests who prefer an independent vacation style will find a suitable base here. The atmosphere is relaxed and tailored to the practical needs of travelers.
